newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Peaceful end to hostage drama in Israeli prison.
newsitem.headline: Peaceful end to hostage drama in Israeli prison.

text.p: A 24-hour revolt in an Israeli military jail ended peacefully on Sunday after prisoners released nine wardens they had taken hostage and surrendered to police.
Officials said negotiators reached a deal with the prisoners but refused to disclose its contents.
About 100 prisoners at Jail Six near Haifa had held the unarmed wardens at knife-point since early on Saturday. Israel Radio said they had stolen the knives from a prison workshop.

"Their main demand...was that long-term prisoners not be transferred to civilian prisons. They know that in military prisons they get good treatment," said Brigadier-General Gideon Sheffer, head of the army's personnel branch who oversaw the negotiations.
"The prison is now back to normal," an army spokesman said, adding that the army had established a committee to investigate circumstances of the revolt and consider prisoners' demands.
